warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the curved-surface canonical Poisson-bracket kernels (annulus metric), the P1 basis, reflecting species boundaries and the energy-moment diagnostic. In `rt_can_pb_bgk_surf_annulus_sodshock_im_1x2v_p1.c`, `nl` (line 69) is the inner density of the discontinuity; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong metric or inverse metric, a wrong reflecting boundary or a wrong energy moment changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 5.1e-4 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 3.7e-4 (worst files `neut-energy-moment.gkyl` and `neut-energy-moment.gkyl`), a headroom of about 1980x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
